summary: Phase 2 of 8 complete: landed the additive unionSound combinator and 18-entry per-tag validity table in a new file, Cslib/Logics/Modal/Metalogic/SchemaSoundness.lean, plus the generic SchemaUnion elimination API additively appended to Cslib/Logics/Modal/ProofSystem/SchemaUnion.lean. `FrameValidatesTag` is defined uniformly over all 18 tags (True for the 13 frame-unconditional tags; the exact frame-condition hypothesis -- reflexivity/seriality/symmetry/transitivity/Euclideanness -- for modalT/D/B/Four/Five). `unionSound (S) (m) (hfc : forall t in S, FrameValidatesTag m t) {phi} (h : SchemaUnion S phi) (w) : Satisfies m w phi` is the single master soundness lemma: the 13 frame-unconditional branches reuse Metalogic/Soundness.lean's existing atoms verbatim (Satisfies.implyK_axiom, ..., Satisfies.diaDualityBack_axiom); the 5 differentiator branches thread hfc's hval straight through as the explicit frame-hypothesis argument to the task-522 FrameCorrespondence.lean lemmas (Satisfies.modalT_axiom, modalFour_axiom, modalB_axiom, modalD_axiom, modalFive_axiom) with no inline frame reasoning. The elimination API (SchemaUnion.empty_iff, SchemaUnion.insert_iff, SchemaUnion.union_iff, all @[simp]) additively extends SchemaUnion.lean so a concrete SchemaUnion sysTags phi rewrites via simp into a named tag disjunction. Zero sorry, zero new axiom. Scoped `lake build` for both modules, `lake exe checkInitImports`, full `lake lint`, and `lake exe lint-style` all green. Stopping here per single-phase dispatch scope; Phases 3-8 not started.
